subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Place value (numbers to 700)
source.subtopic: Decompose numbers up to 700 into multiples of hundreds, tens and ones

show.line: Six hundred and fifty three. 600 plus 50 plus 3. Break it up, then put it back together!

rounds.prompt: Tap the number that is 500 plus 40 plus 2.
rounds.praise: Yes! Five hundred and forty two.

rounds.prompt: Break up 618. Which cards show it?
rounds.praise: Yes! Six hundred, ten and eight.

rounds.prompt: What is the seven worth in 705? Say the number.
Which number has a zero in the ones place?
Four hundred and nine. Tap the number.
rounds.praise: Yes! Four hundreds, no tens, nine ones.

rounds.prompt: Which place? Sort the cards into hundreds, tens and ones.

rounds.praise: Yes! Nine tens beat eight tens.

hints: Hundreds first, then tens, then ones.
Zero holds a place. 603 has no tens.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will build 570 with cards.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! 500 and 7 is 507. 570 needs a 70 card.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's build it together. 500, 70, and zero ones. 570!

parent_line: Can break numbers up to 700 into hundreds, tens and ones.
